title: DUT Synthetic Population Generation
summary: A synthetic population data generator for Daejeon and Sejong, South Korea, that trains CTAB-GAN-Plus on travel survey data to produce realistic tabular datasets while preserving statistical properties. It uses SDV's metadata schema and evaluate_quality/column-plot functions from sdv.evaluation.single_table to assess synthetic data quality against the original data.
